name: button
use: Use buttons to start actions.

name: confirmation-dialog
note: Asks before an action that cannot be undone, and names what will be lost.
use: Asks before an action that cannot be undone, and names what will be lost.

name: dropdown
use: A dropdown can open a menu or another element when the user clicks the button.

name: fab
use: A FAB is a floating action button that stays in a bottom corner of the screen. It contains a focusable, accessible element with a button role. When the user clicks or focuses it, more speed-dial buttons appear. These buttons have a vertical or quarter-circle arrangement.

name: modal
use: A modal shows a dialog or box when the user clicks a button.

name: swap
use: Use the swap component to change the visibility of two elements. Control the swap with a checkbox or a class name.

name: theme-controller
note: On its own it changes the theme without saving it, and it cannot say that the theme should follow the system. The shell uses its class inside a form that saves the choice: see Settings.
use: If a checked checkbox or radio input has the `theme-controller` class, the page uses the theme in the input value.

name: accordion
use: Use the accordion to show and hide content. Only one item can be open at a time.

name: avatar
use: Use an avatar to show a thumbnail image.

name: badge
use: Use a badge to show the status of data.

name: card
use: Use cards to group and show content.

name: carousel
use: Use a carousel to show images or content in a scrollable area.

name: chart
note: A figure with its text summary and its data as a table, drawn with Chart.js.
use: A figure with its text summary and its data as a table, drawn with Chart.js.

name: chat
use: A chat bubble shows one line of a conversation and its related data. This data can include the author image, name, and time.

name: collapse
use: Use the collapse component to show and hide content.

name: countdown
use: A countdown gives a transition effect when a number changes from 0 through 999.

name: description-list
note: A list of terms and their values, for one record's details.
use: A list of terms and their values, for one record's details.

name: diff
use: Use the diff component to show a side-by-side comparison of two items.

name: hover-3d
use: The hover 3D component is a wrapper that adds a 3D effect to its content. When the pointer is on the component, the component tilts and turns in relation to the pointer position.

name: hover-gallery
use: A hover gallery is a container for images. The first image is visible by default. When the pointer moves horizontally on it, the other images appear. Use a hover gallery for product cards, e-commerce sites, portfolios, or image galleries. A hover gallery can contain a maximum of 10 images.

name: kbd
use: Use the kbd component to show keyboard shortcuts.

name: list
use: Use a list to show information in rows in a vertical layout.

name: stat
use: Use a stat component to show numbers and data in a block.

name: status
use: A status is a small icon that shows the current state of an element. Example states are online, offline, and error.

name: table
use: Use a table to show data in rows and columns.

name: text-rotate
note: Moves on its own and only a pointer can pause it: WCAG 2.2.2.
use: Text rotate can show a maximum of six text lines, one line at a time. It uses a continuous loop animation. The default animation time is 10 seconds. The animation pauses when the pointer is on the text.

name: timeline
use: Use a timeline to show a list of events in chronological order.

name: breadcrumbs
use: Use breadcrumbs to help users navigate.

name: dock
use: A dock is also called bottom navigation or a bottom bar. It gives navigation options and stays at the bottom of the screen.

name: link
use: The link component adds an underline to links.

name: menu
use: Use a menu to show a list of links vertically or horizontally.

name: navbar
use: Use a navbar to show navigation at the top of the page.

name: pagination
use: Pagination is a group of buttons.

name: steps
use: Use the steps component to show a sequence in a process.

name: tab
use: Use tabs to show a list of links in a tabbed format.

name: alert
use: Use an alert to give users information about an important event.

name: loading
use: Use the loading component to show an animation while a process runs.

name: progress
use: Use a progress bar to show task progress or the passage of time.

name: conflict-notice
note: Says that someone else saved first, and what they saved, above what was typed.
use: Says that someone else saved first, and what they saved, above what was typed.

name: radial-progress
use: Use the radial progress component to show task progress or the passage of time.

name: skeleton
use: Use a skeleton component to show a loading state.

name: toast
use: A toast is a wrapper that stacks elements in a corner of the page.

name: tooltip
use: A tooltip shows a message when the pointer is on an element.

name: calendar
note: It only styles a calendar library, which is not included. Use a date field.
use: The calendar component includes styles for different calendar libraries.

name: checkbox
use: Use a checkbox to select or deselect a value.

name: date-field
note: The browser's own date field, read by the server in one strict form.
use: The browser's own date field, read by the server in one strict form.

name: error-summary
note: Every problem of a form in one place, each a link to its field.
use: Every problem of a form in one place, each a link to its field.

name: field-error
note: What is wrong with one field, and how to fix it, tied to that field.
use: What is wrong with one field, and how to fix it, tied to that field.

name: fieldset
use: Use a fieldset as a container for related form elements. Use `fieldset-legend` as the title. Use `label` as the description.

name: file-input
use: Use a file input to upload files.

name: filter
use: A filter is a group of radio buttons. When the user selects an option, the filter hides the other options. It also shows a reset button next to the selected option.

name: filter-bar
note: A plain form that filters a list on the server. daisyUI's filter is a set of radio buttons.
use: A plain form that filters a list on the server. daisyUI's filter is a set of radio buttons.

name: form-actions
note: The main action of a form, the way out, and anything else at the far end.
use: The main action of a form, the way out, and anything else at the far end.

name: input
use: Use a text input as a simple input field.

name: label
use: Use a label to give a name or title to an input field. Put the label before or after the field.

name: number-field
note: Text a person types as their language writes numbers. Never a float.
use: Text a person types as their language writes numbers. Never a float.

name: otp
use: An OTP is a one-time password component that lets a user enter a verification code. The code usually contains four to six digits. Use it for two-factor authentication (2FA) or passwordless login.

name: radio
use: Use radio buttons to let the user select one option.

name: range
use: Move a range-slider handle to select a value.

name: rating
use: A rating is a set of radio buttons that lets the user give a rating.

name: searchable-select
note: A list to type in, by keyboard, that is a plain select without JavaScript.
use: A list to type in, by keyboard, that is a plain select without JavaScript.

name: select
use: Use a select component to select a value from a list of options.

name: textarea
use: A textarea lets users enter text on more than one line.

name: toggle
use: A toggle is a checkbox with the style of a switch button.

name: validator
use: The validator class sets an error color or a success color on a form element. The input validation rules control the color.

name: aura
use: An aura adds a light effect around the border of a component. Use it to make an important button, card, or div easy to see.

name: divider
use: Use a divider to separate content vertically or horizontally.

name: drawer
note: Its button is a label, which a keyboard cannot reach: WCAG 2.1.1. The shell uses a popover instead.
use: A drawer is a grid layout that can show and hide a sidebar. The sidebar can be on either side of the page.

name: footer
use: A footer can contain a logo, a copyright notice, and links to other pages.

name: hero
use: Use a hero to show a large box or image with a title and description.

name: indicator
use: Use an indicator to put an element at the corner of another element.

name: join
use: A join is a container that groups more than one item. Use it to group buttons, inputs, or other elements. The join applies a border radius to the first and last items. It can make a horizontal or vertical list of items.

name: mask
use: A mask crops the content of an element to a common shape.

name: megamenu
use: A megamenu is a large horizontal menu. Each item opens a popover that shows a large group of navigation links. Use one megamenu at the top of the page. Each popover can contain a daisyUI menu or custom content. Use a megamenu on large screens. On small screens, hide it and show its content in a dropdown or drawer.

name: stack
use: A stack puts elements on top of each other.

name: mockup-browser
use: A browser mockup is a box in the form of a browser window.

name: mockup-code
use: Use a code mockup to show code in a box with the style of a code editor.

name: mockup-phone
use: A phone mockup shows an iPhone mockup.

name: mockup-window
use: A window mockup is a box in the form of an operating-system window.
